note: The Agent API agent wallet is custodied by OutLayer. Policy changes that alter the wallet's native rules are stored on-chain as a delegate action calling store_wallet_policy on outlayer.near, relayed by the Agent API. The on-chain version counts stored policies; the API revision also counts changes that needed no on-chain write (revision 2 reported no transaction hash and is not listed).
